title: calendars-client: CalendarEventGetParams cites §5.4 and carries non--34 /get arguments
description: Found in spec-sync batch 1 (calendars-34). CalendarEventGetParams and the 'Fetch CalendarEvent objects by IDs' doc in crate-jmap-calendars-client cite -34 §5.4, but CalendarEvent/get is §5.7. Its fields expandRecurrences, reducedParticipants, fetchCalendars are not -34 /get arguments; the real ones are reduceParticipants, recurrenceOverridesBefore, recurrenceOverridesAfter, timeZone. Fix the citation and the argument set (breaking for the client API; check the server side accepts the -34 names).
